authority.goldSource: current frozen canonical occurrence Gold; unchanged
authority.goldScope: Gold primary source aliases owned by parser/binder-valid P6N-B packs only; each scoped Gold identity has exactly one pack owner
authority.pairedSubset: same valid P05 pack identities for P6M and P6N-B; response-overflow pack excluded from both arms
authority.full31Metric: NOT_EVALUABLE_INCOMPLETE_P6NB_RESPONSE; the length-finished pack is retained in cohort records but is not counted as empty/no-proposal/FN
authority.semantic: P6M heading membership is DOCUMENT_IDENTITY or STRUCTURAL_REGION; all bound P6N-B headings are free semantic proposals; TP by source-span overlap
authority.exact: document-scoped ordered source parts and exact UTF16 spans equal Gold parts
authority.falsePositiveReview: all scored semantic FPs checked against source-review verdicts; absent review item defaults NON_HEADING as prior cohort scorer
